data.description: Japanese manga style four-panel comic strip about a music performance negotiation. Panel 1: A businesswoman named Jane in suit says "We want to invite Teacher Xiao Ai for a performance!" with enthusiastic expression. Panel 2: A female guitar teacher Xiao Ai with long dark hair, bangs, wearing white sweater, sitting calmly says "Lets not talk about fees yet, we must test the sound equipment first" with professional expression. Panel 3: Jane wiping sweat nervously says "We have operated concerts before, the equipment is no problem" looking anxious. Panel 4: Xiao Ai smiling gently asks "So what is the budget?" while Jane is shocked and frozen like a statue. Anime style, manga panels, clean lines, expressive characters, comedic timing, professional negotiation scene, warm colors, detailed backgrounds.
